title: Endothelial Function in Lower Extremity Bypass Grafts
brief_summary: This study will determine whether or not saphenous vein \[arterial\] bypass grafts in the leg relax in response to increases in blood flow.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults who have undergone femoral artery to above-knee popliteal artery saphenous vein bypass grafts

Exclusion Criteria:

* Amputation beyond the toes
* Critical limb ischemia defined as rest pain, non-healing ulceration or gangrene
* Pregnancy
